errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.message: The app hit an unexpected error. Try again, and if it keeps happening, restart the app.

settings.title: Settings
settings.viewAsHint: There's only one account for now — switch sides to see what your partner sees, accept invites, and complete shared habits from their side.
settings.resetSampleMessage: This replaces all habits, completions and goals with the demo set.
settings.clearAllMessage: Deletes every habit, completion and goal on this device. This can't be undone.
